getting_started.label: Getting started
getting_started.title: Up and running in 5 steps
getting_started.intro: Follow this order when first setting up WinProx for your organisation.

step_1_text: Create operational teams, assign a team lead and add workers. Link teams to categories so tasks always reach the right team.
step_2_text: Add locations (sites, buildings, floors) and create units per location — these are the assets, machines or spaces on which issues and tasks are registered.
step_3_text: Print QR codes from the unit or location detail page and attach them visibly. Reporters scan the unit QR to submit an issue; workers scan the team QR to start tasks.
step_4_text: Issues come in via QR scan or manually. Assign a task to a team, set a deadline and track progress via the dashboard and calendar.
step_5_text: Workers complete tasks on the floor via the team QR. Once all tasks are handled, the administrator closes the issue. Everything is visible in the audit trail.
